mechanism: Carbamazepine induces the metabolism of valproate via CYP450 enzymes, reducing valproate levels by 30-50%, while valproate inhibits carbamazepine metabolism and may increase its active metabolite (carbamazepine-10,11-epoxide), creating bidirectional interaction with potential loss of seizure control and/or toxicity.
action: Monitor serum concentrations of both drugs frequently; adjust doses based on levels and clinical response; consider alternative antiepileptic combinations if seizure control is inadequate or toxicity emerges.
